title: Senior Architect
description:
**Job Summary** 

 We are seeking a hands\-on, high\-impact Senior Technical Architect (Platform Backend) to lead the architecture, scaling, and continuous evolution of our core platform infrastructure. In this role, you will operate at the intersection of high\-throughput transactional systems and cloud\-native architecture. You will be responsible for driving high\-level and low\-level designs (HLD/LLD), establishing engineering guardrails, optimizing complex data pathways, and collaborating directly with product and engineering leaders to ensure absolute reliability, performance, and low latency at scale.
 


 Key Responsibilities:System Design \& Architectural Leadership:
 * Own the end\-to\-end High\-Level Design (HLD) and Low\-Level Design (LLD) for core platform services, asynchronous processing components, and enterprise ERP/bank integration adapters.
* Facilitate a smooth transition from monolithic legacy boundaries into clean, highly cohesive microservices domains without impacting uptime or data integrity.
* Establish architectural governance, lead Architecture Review Boards (ARBs), and review critical pull requests to safeguard code quality, clean architecture principles, and SOLID design patterns.


 Scalability, Performance \& Reliability:
 * Architect multi\-tenant, cloud\-native frameworks capable of handling high\-concurrency and petabyte\-scale financial transactions with strict SLAs.
* Diagnose and eliminate system bottlenecks across distributed transactions, locking models, memory management, and network payloads.
* Oversee zero\-trust security compliance, fault\-tolerance mechanisms, automated failover policies, and disaster recovery readiness.


 Data \& Integration Architecture:
 * Design robust relational (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and non\-relational database schemas, complex indexing strategies, data partitioning models, and archival frameworks.
* Scale event\-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka or similar messaging systems to manage reliable real\-time data streaming and asynchronous decoupling.
* Optimize high\-throughput caching architectures (using Redis) to minimize database overhead for intensive financial computations.


 Engineering Culture \& Execution:
 * Act as a technical multiplier by mentoring senior engineers, driving proof\-of\-concepts (PoCs) for emerging technologies, and cultivating an environment of fast, first\-principles execution.
* Collaborate closely with Product Management to scope technical roadmaps, decompose epic requirements into modular milestones, and proactively mitigate technical debt.


 Required Skills
 
 A technically deep engineering/product leader with:
 


* **Experience:** 
 12 \- 16 years of professional software engineering experience, with a minimum of 3 years successfully operating in a Technical Architect or Principal Engineer capacity for enterprise SaaS products.
* **Core Backend Stack:** 
 Expert\-level mastery of Java (Java 17\+), Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and enterprise\-grade backend frameworks. A profound understanding of JVM internals, garbage collection tuning, multi\-threading, and high\-concurrency programming models.
* **Distributed Systems \& Messaging:** 
 Proven experience in building distributed microservices, RESTful APIs, gRPC, and event\-driven architectures utilizing Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ.
* **Database \& Storage Expertise:** 
 Advanced proficiency in SQL and NoSQL storage engines (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis). Hands\-on capability with query execution plans, partitioning, and database tuning under heavy write/read loads.
* **Cloud \& DevOps Infrastructure:** 
 Solid production experience with AWS (or Azure/GCP), containerization technologies (Docker), cluster orchestration (Kubernetes), and enterprise CI/CD deployment pipelines.

title: Senior Implementation Consultant – CRM Data Migration
description:
**Position: Senior Implementation Consultant CRM Data Migration**
**Location:Hyderabad (8:00PM to 5:00 AM IST)**
**Work Type: Full\-Time**
**Experience: 8\+ Years**
**PETADATA is looking for a Senior Implementation Consultant CRM Data Migration with strong experience in CRM implementation, configuration, customization, and business process optimization.**
**Roles \& Responsibilities**
**CRM Implementation \& Migration**
* Configure and build CRM migration use cases across platforms such as Salesforce, Zoho, HubSpot, and other CRM systems.
* Work with CRM objects/modules, custom fields, record types, relationships, associations, attachments, notes, activities, and historical data.
* Translate real\-world customer requirements and CRM scenarios into comprehensive migration test cases.
* Configure source\-to\-target mappings, transformations, and migration logic within the data migration platform.
* Develop field mappings, transformation rules, migration plans, and validation criteria based on customer requirements.


**Testing \& Data Quality**
* Execute trial and production migrations and validate results in the target CRM.
* Perform record\-count validation, field\-level validation, relationship validation, deduplication, and data\-integrity checks.
* Identify and troubleshoot migration issues such as field\-type mismatches, picklist/option\-set differences, API limitations, duplicate records, character encoding, and large\-volume data handling.
* Develop structured test cases and validation checklists to ensure migration accuracy and completeness.
* Document migration findings and collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to improve migration capabilities and reliability.


**Customer Delivery \& Implementation**
* Work directly with customers to scope, plan, and execute CRM migration projects.
* Understand customer source and target systems, data models, data volumes, business requirements, and migration success criteria.
* Lead trial migrations, review results with customers, incorporate feedback, and prepare for production cutover.
* Execute production migrations, validate cutover results, and provide go\-live support.
* Manage data cleansing, deduplication, transformation, and relationship preservation requirements throughout the engagement.
* Serve as the primary customer contact during implementation, managing expectations, timelines, project communication, and delivery status.
* Train customer teams on validating migrated data and using the migration platform where appropriate.


**Documentation \& Delivery Standards**
* Create and maintain clear migration plans, mapping specifications, validation reports, and handover/runbook documentation.
* Develop reusable migration use cases, mapping templates, validation checklists, and implementation assets.
* Establish and document delivery best practices to improve the speed, consistency, and quality of future migrations.
* Mentor junior implementation consultants and contribute to improving team delivery standards.


**Note: Should be able to work independently and work in USA time zones**
**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* 8\+ years of experience in information security, GRC, or security compliance, preferably within SaaS/software environments.
* Hands\-on experience leading SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 certifications end to end, including gap assessments, controls, evidence, audits, and remediation.
* Strong expertise in SaaS security, multi\-tenant security, cloud security, IAM, encryption, data segregation, and audit logging.
* Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure and the cloud shared\-responsibility model.
* Experience securing on\-premise/customer\-deployed software, including hardening, secure deployment, and compliance requirements.
* Strong knowledge of GRC, risk management, control frameworks, ISMS, audits, and continuous compliance.
* Knowledge of GDPR, CCPA, and customer data privacy requirements.
* Experience with vulnerability management, penetration testing, incident response, business continuity, disaster recovery, and vendor risk management.
* Strong skills in security policies, compliance documentation, audit evidence, risk assessments, and control management.
* Ability to work effectively with auditors, engineers, customers, vendors, and executives.
* Strong customer security and trust experience, including security questionnaires, RFPs, customer audits, and vendor assessments.
* Highly self\-directed, with the ability to build and manage a security and compliance program independently.
* Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer, or Lead Audito


**Education**
**Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.**
**Candidates are required to attend Phone/video calls and in\-person interviews. After the Selection, the candidate (He/She) should undergo all background checks on Education and Experience.**
**Please email your resume to varshitham@petadata.ai**
**After carefully reviewing your experience and skills, one of our HR team members will contact you on the next steps**

description:

title: Senior Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
**JOB DATA**
 JOB TITLE: Senior Consultant
   

  

**About Intangent**
 We are North America's fastest growing Sales Performance Management consultancy. We've grown rapidly by working with the best and brightest in our industry. Our high performing consulting team and market\-leading vendor partners reflect Intangent's unwavering focus on best execution in customer experience.  Visit us at https://intangent.com/
   

  

**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced
 **Xactly Consultant** 
 with a strong focus on
 **Xactly Incent** 
 and
 **Xactly Analytics** 
 to join our team. The successful candidate will lead the implementation, configuration, and optimization of Xactly solutions, providing clients with cutting\-edge tools to manage their incentive compensation programs and gain data\-driven insights. This role requires deep technical expertise in Xactly’s Incentive Compensation and Analytics platforms, alongside a solid understanding of Sales Performance Management (SPM) frameworks.
   

  

**Desired Skills And Experience**
**Xactly Incent Implementation \& Configuration** 
 :
   

  

* Lead the end\-to\-end configuration and implementation of Xactly Incent, including designing compensation plans, setting up quotas, crediting rules, and calculating commission payouts.
* Customize Compensation Rules to reflect complex commission structures, such as tiered payouts, accelerators, draws, and recoveries, based on client\-specific business requirements.
* Configure and manage participant hierarchies, team structures, and territory assignments, ensuring accurate compensation tracking.
* Create and maintain calculation formulas, including base pay, bonuses, and multi\-variable commissions, using Xactly’s Calculation Engine.
* Handle the credit assignment process, including splitting credits between multiple participants or roles and ensuring accurate credit allocation to sales activities.
* Configure and manage Plan Documents and Participant Statements, ensuring transparency and clarity in commission reporting.
* Perform data loading and integration of various input sources (e.g., CRM data from Salesforce, ERP systems, or manual files) using Xactly's Connect integration tool.
* Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate the functionality of the system and ensure the accuracy of calculations.
* Set up and manage dispute workflows, providing users with mechanisms to contest commissions and ensuring proper audit trails.


**Xactly Analytics And Reporting**
* Develop and configure Xactly Analytics dashboards and custom reports to provide clients with real\-time visibility into performance metrics, incentive payouts, and sales effectiveness.
* Build advanced reporting frameworks to track critical metrics, such as quota attainment, sales by product, compensation by territory, and team performance.
* Utilize Xactly Analytics' data visualization tools to design and present intuitive charts and graphs that highlight key insights for executives and sales leaders.
* Configure custom calculation logic for reporting purposes, including aggregate functions like year\-over\-year comparisons, trend analysis, and commission forecasting.
* Implement role\-based security in Xactly Analytics to ensure proper data access controls, enabling different levels of visibility for stakeholders (e.g., sales reps, managers, and executives).


**Qualifications**
* 4\+ years of experience in a software development or systems analyst role
* Must be comfortable with emerging technologies, learning new software, understanding a data model and an object model, writing SQL queries, and writing design specifications
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* 3\-5 years of experience implementing Xactly Incent and Xactly Analytics.


**Technical \& Business Requirements**
* Knowledge of software development \& implementation life cycles
* Experience with major relational databases (Oracle, SQL Server, etc.)
* Proficient in Xactly Incent configuration, including:
+ Compensation Plan Design: Structuring and configuring incentive compensation plans, defining quotas, crediting rules, and payout methods.
+ Participant Management: Setting up and managing user hierarchies, teams, roles, and permissions.
+ Calculation Engine: Building custom formulas, handling complex calculation rules (e.g., weighted commissions, bonuses).
+ Plan Document Automation: Configuring automated and customizable participant statements and documents.
+ Quota Management: Configuring and managing quota\-setting processes.

* Expertise in Xactly Analytics configuration and reporting:
+ Advanced Data Modeling: Designing and configuring custom reports and dashboards.
+ Complex Report Building: Developing performance dashboards that aggregate sales data and compensation metrics.


**Knowledge Of The Following Technologies Is Considered An Asset**
* Microsoft SQL Server, Informatica, Xactly, Varicent
* Web technologies such as JavaScript, XML, CSS, and HTML
* BI Cognos reporting


 SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS)

title: Development Associate Director
description:
Are you ready to make an impact at DTCC?
   

  

 Do you want to work on innovative projects, collaborate with a dynamic and supportive team, and receive investment in your professional development? At DTCC, we are at the forefront of innovation in the financial markets. We are committed to helping our employees grow and succeed. We believe that you have the skills and drive to make a real impact. We foster a thriving internal community and are committed to creating a workplace that looks like the world that we serve.
   

  

 The Information Technology group delivers secure, reliable technology solutions that enable DTCC to be the trusted infrastructure of the global capital markets. The team delivers high\-quality information through activities that include development of essential, building infrastructure capabilities to meet client needs and implementing data standards and governance.
   

  

**Pay And Benefits**
* Competitive compensation, including base pay and annual incentive
* Comprehensive health and life insurance and well\-being benefits, based on location
* Pension / Retirement benefits
* Paid Time Off and Personal/Family Care, and other leaves of absence when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well\-being.
* DTCC offers a flexible/hybrid model of 3 days onsite and 2 days remote (onsite Tuesdays, Wednesdays and a third day unique to each team or employee).


**The Impact You Will Have In This Role**
 We are seeking a seasoned Associate Director – Technology Lead to provide hands‑on engineering leadership and delivery oversight across Appian (Low‑Code BPM), Talend (Data Integration), and SQL‑based data platforms. This role is critical to improving release predictability, production stability, and engineering quality across globally distributed teams.
   

  

 The successful candidate will combine deep technical foundations with exceptional leadership, delivery discipline, and stakeholder management. This role is accountable not only for what we build, but how reliably and sustainably we deliver enterprise\-grade solutions.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone who can set standards, enforce rigor, coach teams, and partner with business and technology stakeholders to ensure scalable, resilient, and high\-quality outcomes.
   

  

**Your Primary Responsibilities**
 Technology \& Engineering Leadership
   

  

* Provide clear technical vision and strategic direction across Appian, Talend, and SQL\-based platforms.
* Establish and enforce solution architecture standards, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices.
* Serve as the senior technical authority, reviewing designs and challenging solutions that introduce delivery, scalability, or operational risk.
* Drive consistent adoption of enterprise engineering principles, including modularity, reusability, performance, and security\-by\-design.


 Delivery Excellence \& Operational Rigor
   

  

* Own end‑to‑end delivery accountability, from solution design through development, testing, release, and production stabilization.
* Address historical delivery issues by strengthening release readiness, defect prevention, and root\-cause remediation practices.
* Implement and govern SDLC controls, including design reviews, code quality standards, testing expectations, and production readiness criteria.
* Actively manage delivery risk, dependencies, and cross\-team coordination, particularly across globally distributed teams.
* Ensure predictable delivery through strong planning discipline, execution tracking, and escalation management.


 Quality, Stability \& Continuous Improvement
   

  

* Drive a quality\-first culture, prioritizing defect prevention over detection.
* Partner with QA and DevOps teams to improve test automation, CI/CD maturity, deployment reliability, and rollback strategies.
* Analyze production issues and missed delivery commitments to identify systemic gaps and implement sustainable corrective actions.
* Define and track engineering metrics (e.g., defect leakage, release stability, cycle time) to continuously improve delivery performance.


 Platform \& Domain Leadership
   

  

* Lead and mentor multi\-disciplinary, global engineering teams, including: \- Appian BPM developers
* Talend data integration engineers
* SQL / data engineers
* Provide technical leadership for: \- Appian\-based workflow, BPM, and low‑code solutions
* Talend ETL / ELT pipelines and data integration architecture
* SQL data modeling, performance tuning, and optimization for enterprise workloads
* Ensure platform solutions are scalable, supportable, and aligned with enterprise data and integration standards.


 People Leadership \& Talent Development
   

  

* Build and lead high\-performing engineering teams through coaching, performance management, and career development.
* Set clear expectations for accountability, ownership, and engineering excellence.
* Identify skill gaps and drive targeted upskilling across architecture, quality, and modern delivery practices.
* Foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous learning across geographies and functions.


 Stakeholder \& Enterprise Engagement
   

  

* Act as a trusted technology partner to product owners, business leaders, architects, and platform teams.
* Translate business objectives into practical, scalable technology solutions with clear delivery commitments.
* Provide concise, executive\-ready communication on delivery status, risks, and mitigation strategies.


**Qualifications**
* 12–15 years of technology experience, with 5\+ years in senior leadership roles overseeing enterprise delivery.
* Proven success leading cross\-functional, globally distributed engineering teams.
* Experience in large enterprise or financial services environments, with an appreciation for regulatory, risk, and operational controls


**Talents Needed For Success**
* Strong, hands\-on experience with Appian BPM architecture and low\-code development (L2 or L3 certification strongly preferred).
* Appian L2 or L3 certification preferred.
* Advanced expertise in SQL databases, including data modeling, performance tuning, data lineage, and governance considerations.
* Proven experience producing HLDs and LLDs, and leading complex system and data integrations.
* Solid understanding of APIs, microservices, and SaaS\-based integrations.
* Demonstrated experience with Talend or equivalent ETL/data integration platforms.
* Practical experience implementing DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and automation across enterprise platforms.


 Actual salary is determined based on the role, location, individual experience, skills, and other considerations. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

title: Senior Cloud Database Engineer - Automation & Terraform

**Position Summary**
 Design and develop AI/GenAI solutions for Commercial Pharma data use cases, including enterprise knowledge search, insight generation, AI agents, natural language analytics and productivity accelerators. The role works from Vizag with data, platform, governance and business teams to build secure and scalable AI capabilities.
   

  

**Business / Program Context**
 The role is part of a Vizag\-based delivery capability supporting Commercial Pharma datasets across global markets. The work may include platform operations, data engineering, data quality, reporting, AI enablement, release governance and stakeholder support for enterprise commercial data products. The role is not limited to Japan\-specific datasets; Japan market familiarity may be useful but is not a mandatory baseline requirement for most positions.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
* Develop GenAI applications, AI agents and RAG\-based solutions for commercial data use cases.
* Build prompt engineering patterns, retrieval pipelines, LLM integration and model evaluation workflows.
* Use Databricks AI/Mosaic AI capabilities where applicable for model serving, vector search and experimentation.
* Integrate AI solutions with curated commercial datasets, knowledge bases, metadata and documentation repositories.
* Implement guardrails for security, privacy, accuracy, hallucination reduction and responsible AI usage.
* Partner with AI/Data Engineers, Platform Engineers and business stakeholders to industrialize AI solutions.
* Document solution design, evaluation metrics, prompts, data sources and governance controls.
* Work as part of a Vizag\-based delivery team supporting Commercial Pharma datasets and global commercial data stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business, technology, governance, quality and offshore/onshore delivery teams across time zones.
* Follow Agile delivery, SDLC, documentation, release, validation, access\-control and data\-governance standards.
* Contribute to knowledge management, reusable assets, SOPs, runbooks and operational excellence initiatives.
* Maintain strong communication discipline, including status updates, risk identification, issue escalation and timely stakeholder follow\-through.


**Required Work Experience**
* 4–8 years of relevant experience aligned to the role and seniority level.
* Prior experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, healthcare analytics, commercial data platforms or enterprise data programs.
* Experience working in a global delivery model with structured governance, documentation, SLAs and stakeholder communication.
* Ability to work from Vizag and collaborate effectively with India, global and client teams.


**Technical / Functional Skills**
* Python
* LLM integration
* RAG and Vector Databases
* Databricks AI / Mosaic AI
* Prompt engineering
* LangChain/LlamaIndex or equivalent
* Model evaluation
* AI governance and responsible AI


**Commercial Pharma Dataset Exposure**
* Pharmaceutical commercial data platforms
* Sales, prescription, claims, CRM and omnichannel datasets
* Customer master, HCP/HCO, product master, territory and alignment datasets
* Commercial KPIs, field force effectiveness, market share and promotional effectiveness
* Data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata and controlled release processes


**Desirable Skills**
* Experience supporting global pharma companies or commercial data programs.
* Exposure to Eisai\-like commercial operating models, field reporting, sales operations and analytics use cases.
* Japan market dataset exposure is preferred but not mandatory unless the assignment requires direct Japan business engagement.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain data, risks, defects and business impact clearly.
* Certifications in Databricks, Informatica IDMC, Azure/AWS, Scrum, ITIL, Tableau/Power BI or AI/ML are preferred depending on role.


**Success Measures / KPIs**
* Secure, useful and governed AI solutions with measurable productivity, search, analysis or decision\-support value.


**Indicative 30 / 60 / 90 Day Expectations**
* First 30 days: complete onboarding, understand commercial data landscape, delivery processes, documentation standards and role\-specific tools.
* First 60 days: independently contribute to assigned workstreams, support issue resolution, produce required artifacts and participate in governance forums.
* First 90 days: demonstrate measurable ownership, improve delivery quality, identify improvement opportunities and support stable operations or project outcomes.

description:
Your opportunity
   

  

 At Charles Schwab, our purpose is simple: we champion client’s goals with passion and integrity. Guided by honesty, mutual respect and a commitment to doing what’s right, we bring innovation, education, and service together to help shape financial futures. Our people are the foundation of our success – they approach their work with curiosity and collaboration, coming together to create solutions that make a meaningful impact for clients and communities. As we expand into India, we are bringing this same culture of inclusion, learning, and opportunity to new talent. Joining us means becoming part of a global team where your work matters and your future can take shape.
   

  

 Our Hyderabad location is central to Schwab’s growth, bringing together talented people and technology to drive innovation, scale and efficiency. Here, you will work alongside teams who create solutions that support millions of clients every day. The work you do is more than daily operations – it’s a chance to experiment, learn, and build within a values\-driven, supportive environment. This is a unique opportunity to be part of our early growth phase and shape something new, backed by the stability and strength of a Fortune 500 company. Your impact begins on day one, and your contributions will help define our future in the region .
   

  

 What you have
   

  

 Manager, Data Engineering role is a hands\-on QA tester / data engineer position within Schwab Data India focused on validating, testing, and supporting data engineering solutions that enable enterprise\-wide analytics and operational reporting. This role partners closely with product owners, developers, and quality engineering teams to ensure reliable, scalable, and well\-governed data pipelines and platform capabilities aligned with Schwab standards.
   

  

 As part of the OneSchwab/OneGCC model, this QA tester / data engineer contributes to high\-quality delivery through strong testing practices, data validation, automation, defect analysis, operational discipline, and close collaboration across global teams. The role is ideal for a technologist who enjoys ensuring data quality and delivery reliability in a fast\-paced, regulated enterprise environment.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Requirements \& Design Review: Review business requirements, source\-to\-target mappings, and technical design documents to identify validation needs, test coverage gaps, and quality risks, and provide timely engineering feedback.
* Test Planning \& Scenario Coverage: Review requirements, source\-to\-target mappings, and technical designs to identify test scenarios, edge cases, validation rules, and quality risks.
* Data Testing \& Validation: Write and execute SQL\-based data validations, reconcile source and target data, validate transformation logic, support functional and regression testing, and help resolve defects through root\-cause analysis.
* Test Automation: Develop, maintain, and enhance automation scripts and reusable test assets to improve validation coverage, repeatability, and release confidence across data engineering workflows.
* AI\-Assisted Automation Development: Use AI\-assisted tools and techniques responsibly to accelerate development of automation scripts, improve test design efficiency, and strengthen validation productivity while adhering to enterprise engineering and control standards.
* Defect \& Release Support: Coordinate with cross\-functional teams during test cycles and releases, track defects, validate fixes, and ensure timely completion of assigned testing and quality assurance activities.
* Documentation \& Test Standards: Maintain test documentation, validation evidence, reusable QA assets, and engineering artifacts in line with Schwab delivery and control standards.


**Required Qualification**
* 10\+ years of overall experience with strong hands\-on expertise in data engineering testing, ETL validation, QA automation, or data warehouse environments.
* Experience working on large\-scale data testing or data engineering quality assurance initiatives with strong hands\-on ownership of automation development in an Agile delivery model.
* Strong foundation in data validation, defect identification, troubleshooting, and quality engineering best practices across testing lifecycles.
* Ability to work collaboratively across product, development, and QA teams in a fast\-paced enterprise setting.


**Required Experience**
* Hands\-on experience in Data Warehouse and ETL testing, validation, or quality engineering, with demonstrated ability to develop automation scripts for test execution, reconciliation, and validation, preferably using IICS or PowerCenter.
* Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and modern cloud\-based data engineering practices.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, and basic Unix/shell scripting to develop automation scripts and support testing, validation, automation, and troubleshooting.
* Experience using AI\-assisted engineering tools to help create, refine, and optimize automation scripts and testing accelerators while applying sound engineering judgment, validation, and governance.
* Experience with Agile delivery tools such as Jira or Rally, with a solid understanding of software development lifecycle practices.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect diagnosis, test evidence review, and root\-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to manage priorities independently, communicate clearly, and deliver high\-quality work within tight timelines.


**Skills And Attributes**
* Technical Depth: Strong hands\-on capability in data testing, validation, automation script development, and problem solving across enterprise data workflows.
* Quality Mindset: Focused on accuracy, completeness, traceability, and reliability across testing, validation, and release activities.
* Execution Focus: Able to prioritize effectively, work independently, and consistently deliver in a dynamic environment.
* Collaboration: Works well with cross\-functional teams and communicates issues, risks, and progress clearly.
* Continuous Improvement: Looks for opportunities to improve test automation, leverage AI\-assisted development responsibly, streamline validation processes, and strengthen quality engineering practices.


**Preferred Qualification**
* Working knowledge of CI/CD and DevOps tools such as Bamboo, Bitbucket, GitHub
* Finance domain background .


**Job Sub\-Family Specific Competencies**
* Analytical Thinking \- Approaching a problem by using a logical, systematic, sequential approach
* Attention To Communication \- Ensuring that information is passed on to others who should be kept informed
* Business Acumen \- Ability to perform with insight, acuteness, and intelligence in the areas of the industry
* Make decisions and act in situations in which there is not enough information to be certain of outcome or implications of the decision
* Data Engineering Fundamentals – Strategically managing and operationalizing data pipelines and storage systems for data mining, analytics, and machine learning, prioritizing compliance, security, and scalability
* Personal Credibility – Demonstrated concern that one be perceived as responsible, reliable, and trustworthy
* Results Orientation – Focusing on the desired end result of one’s own or one’s units work
* Setting challenging goals, focusing effort on the goals, and meeting or exceeding them


 What’s in it for you
   

  

 At Schwab India, you’re empowered to shape your future. We support your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture rooted in trust and collaboration – so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our benefits are designed to care for your wellbeing, your family, and your long\-term financial security.
   

  

**Our Base Benefits, Wellbeing, And Total Rewards Include**
* Competitive compensation and retirement programs including Employee Provident Fund (EPF), Gratuity, and optional National Pension System (NPS) contributions
* Robust Paid Time Off, including annual/privilege leave, sick and casual leave, public holidays, maternity/paternity leave, and more
* Education assistance for continued learning to help you grow
* Comprehensive medical insurance with Outpatient Department (OPD) services, including vaccination, pharmacy, dental, and vision coverage
* Annual reimbursement for health check\-ups and mental health support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Childcare (creche) reimbursement for eligible employees
* Transportation and meal benefits that support your day\-to\-day work
* Group life, personal accident, and critical illness insurance

**Location:** 
 Bangalore / Chennai / Coimbatore / Kochi / Kolkata / Noida /Hyderabad / Pune / Trivandrum
   

  

 Role Summary
   

  

 The Conversion SME will own the end\-to\-end data and policy conversion strategy for a Life \& Annuities policy administration system transformation (e.g., legacy platform to FAST/Majesco/OIPA/FINEOS target). This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.
* Lead root\-cause analysis on conversion breaks/exceptions and drive remediation with configuration or ETL teams.


**Data Mapping \& Rules Definition**
* Author functional specifications for field\-level, transaction\-level, and history conversion (policy, billing, claims\-in\-progress, agent/commission, correspondence).
* Define exception handling rules for non\-standard policies, riders, or legacy product variants that don't map cleanly to the target chart of accounts/product model.
* Validate mapping specs with source system SMEs and target platform configuration leads.


**Testing \& Reconciliation**
* Design and oversee conversion test cycles (mock conversions, parallel runs, dress rehearsals) and define pass/fail acceptance criteria.
* Own policy\-level and aggregate\-level reconciliation reporting (financial tie\-outs, record counts, value tolerances) presented to governance/steering forums.
* Sign off on conversion readiness gates ahead of each cutover wave.


**Team \& Stakeholder Management**
* Lead and mentor a pod of conversion analysts/testers (onshore/offshore); manage workload, quality, and delivery timelines.
* Act as primary conversion point of contact for client business owners, actuarial, compliance, and IT conversion teams.
* Present conversion status, risk, and exception dashboards to steering committee/PMO.


**Compliance \& Risk**
* Ensure conversion approach aligns with regulatory requirements (state filings, policyholder notification rules, NAIC/IFRS 17 where applicable).
* Maintain audit trail documentation sufficient for internal audit and regulatory examination.


 Must\-Have Skills
   

  

**Category**
**Requirement**
**Domain**
 9
   

  

**Platform**
 Hands\-on conversion experience on at least one target PAS: FAST, Majesco, OIPA, FINEOS, or equivalent legacy modernization platform
   

  

**Conversion\-specific**
 Prior experience in at least one full PAS conversion/migration cycle — mapping, mock conversions, parallel testing, cutover
   

  

**Data**
 Strong SQL skills; experience with data mapping/ETL concepts; policy value reconciliation (cash value, reserves, COI, fund values for annuities)
   

  

**Documentation**
 Ability to write field\-level functional specs, mapping documents, and test scripts to consulting\-grade standards
   

  

**Delivery**
 Experience managing a pod, sprint/wave\-based delivery, and reporting into a governance/PMO structure
   

  

**Regulatory**
 Familiarity with state insurance regulations, policyholder notification requirements, and IFRS 17/statutory reporting impacts on conversion

* Experience with both Life and Annuities product lines (not just one)

* Group Benefits conversion exposure (cross\-domain flexibility)

title: Senior Release Manager
description:
**Summary role description:** 




  





 Hiring for a Senior Technical Release Manager – Product and Professional Services, at Hyderabad, for supporting both standard product releases and custom product implementations for a US\-headquartered InsurTech SaaS platform client.
 



  





**Company description:** 




  





 Our client is a storied InsurTech platform provider whose products suite helps modernize the Life Insurance and Annuities industry. Their market\-leading digital solutions empower insurers with acquiring customers (policyholders) and to servicing their needs across the insurance lifecycle, with scalable, secure, performant and compliant software products for life insurance carriers, and their agents, employees, and consumers. These products are offered in multiple commercial and deployment models, comprising standard multi\-tenant SaaS, multi\-instance implementations, modular products with on\-premises, hosting and cloud deployment options. In this context, the role of the Senior Release Manager is business\-critical, calling for deep technical expertise combined with decision\-making in consultation with multiple client and internal stakeholders.
 



  





**Role details:** 








* **Role:** 
 Senior Technical Release Manager – Product Engineering and Service Transitions
* **Role level:** 
 Senior Manager
* **Reporting Manager:** 
 Head – Customer Success
* **Location:** 
 Hyderabad
* **Work Mode:** 
 Hybrid (2 days work from office, 3 from home)
* **Role type:** 
 Individual Contributor



  





**Role \& responsibilities:** 




  




* Upstream release readiness contribution, especially in an AWS deployment architecture context: Act as a technical gatekeeper, driving deep\-dive release readiness reviews, auditing "Release Manifests" (by validating steps such as SQL migrations or PDF template migrations), temporal workflow versioning for fail\-safe production, using Kafka schemas, and AWS resource configurations. A good overall understanding of deployment architecture in AWS is essential for this role.
* Release Lifecycle Leadership: Hands\-on release and deployment leadership of core platform production updates and for customized deployments, as per Release Calendars agreed with clients and internal product teams
* Release processes design and execution, tooling, and documentation
* Environment Governance: Manage "Instance Parity" across AWS multi\-instance architecture to prevent "Environmental Drift" and ensuring customer\-specific secrets and variables match our global standards
* Cross\-Functional Orchestration: Facilitate formal "Go/No\-Go" decisions by tracking a global checklist that includes technical and non\-technical readiness.
* Risk Mitigation: Identify, document, and mitigate technical sequencing risks (e.g., database locks or stateful workflow conflicts) associated with production releases.
* Continuous Improvement: Monitor release performance, generate and provide metrics and reports and drive the transition from manual coordination to Automated Production Quality Gates within our release pipelines



  





**Requirements:** 




  




* 10\+ years of overall technical experience, with a background in software engineering, SRE, or backend operations, preferably also with expertise in IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation, and principles such as Error Budgets and SLIs/SLOs.
* 5\+ years of direct release management experience in a complex, enterprise hybrid SaaS environment (multi\-tenant and multi\-instance).
* AWS cloud\-native release expertise, covering constructs like EKS, RDS Secrets Manager, IAM, S3, MSK, Containerization (Kubernetes (K8s), ECS or Docker and their deployment patterns (Canary, Blue\-Green, or Rolling Updates).
* Stack fluency in one or more of Typescript, PHP, Go\-lang, Python and Node.js ecosystems, with reference to deployment nuances
* Modern orchestration expertise, including in Temporal (stateful workflows) and Kafka event streaming, with the ability to deploy "in\-flight" asynchronous processes, in a risk\-mitigated manner. You understand the risks of
* Strong database proficiency in MySQL and PostgreSQL, including in migration / transition releases
* Proven communication skills especially while handling release stage gates and Go/No\-go/Phased go type decisions
* Experience in Insurance or FS domains – highly preferred
* Deep knowledge of GRC, including SOC2/ISO, audit processes – highly preferred



  





**Assessment process:** 




  




* Interview by Head – Customer Success
* Interview by / technical interaction DevOps / SRE team
* Interview by Head – DevOps / SRE
* Interview by CTO
* Wrap\-up discussions with HR

description:
**Description**
 The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
   

  

 AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
   

  

 Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
   

  

 The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
   

  

 Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms \& Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
   

  

 You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof\-of\-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora\-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
   

  

 Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte\-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
   

  

 Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
   

  

 Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
   

  

 Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
   

  

 Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
   

  

 Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
   

  

**About The Team**
 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS?
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship \& Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 \& s3\)
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience in advanced SQL \& ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience in Postgres, or experience in software development and experience in SQL Server/MySQL
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non\-technical leaders


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with the AWS platform, web services, software development, or related technologie
* AWS Professional level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
